summary: Frontend-only follow-up verification for MakeMyEvents: (1) PDF filename fix via expo-file-system/legacy import, (2) Upcoming Events KPI moved from dashboard body to header pill. All 8 checks in the review request PASS. Backend health OK (GET /api/ -> 'MakeMyEvents API'). Static verification of /app/frontend/src/invoice.ts confirms 'expo-file-system/legacy' import (line 3) — the legacy module resolves to expo-file-system/src/legacy/FileSystem.ts which exports documentDirectory, cacheDirectory, copyAsync, deleteAsync (verified in node_modules). renameForShare uses documentDirectory preferred with cacheDirectory fallback (line 11) and calls copyAsync + deleteAsync (lines 15-16) with console.warn on failure (line 19). shareInvoice filename is `${sanitizeName(clientName)}_${sanitizeName(id)}.pdf` — no 'Invoice ' prefix (line 180). shareReport filename is `Report_${startISO}_to_${endISO}.pdf` (line 308). Dashboard: KpiCard is no longer rendered in the ScrollView body (only defined but unused; comment on line 96 confirms move). Header contains View with testID='upcoming-pill' between brand block and open-notif-btn (lines 64-67), showing Ionicons calendar (size 12) + kpis.upcomingCount text. styles.upcomingPill has paddingHorizontal:8, paddingVertical:5, borderRadius:12 (line 235). Login screen cold-loads with 'Continue with Google' visible and no red-screen errors.
action_items: Optional cleanup: KpiCard component (dashboard.tsx lines 215-225) is now unused/dead code — safe to remove.
Console warning noted (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow' on web. Coming from RN styles like menuBtn.shadow* and fab.shadow*. Cosmetic web-only warning.
critical_code_review_comments: invoice.ts renameForShare correctly wraps errors in try/catch and falls back to the original uri, so a share still works even if rename fails — good resilience.
sanitizeName strips non-safe filename chars and replaces spaces with underscores — matches expected 'Ananya_Rohit_MME-001.pdf' pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes (legacy FS import for PDF filename, upcoming pill in header) verified statically + login smoke test. To fully verify PDF filename in Sharing dialog, native build required (Sharing.shareAsync isn't triggerable via web preview since shareInvoice returns early on Platform.OS==='web'). Dead KpiCard function in dashboard.tsx can optionally be removed.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration validates the fixes rather than reproducing bugs. Root cause of the PDF filename issue was documented by main agent: expo-file-system v19 moved classic exports (documentDirectory, cacheDirectory, copyAsync, deleteAsync) to the 'expo-file-system/legacy' subpath; importing from the bare package returned undefined for those symbols so renameForShare silently no-op'd. Fix verified: import * as FileSystem from 'expo-file-system/legacy' resolves to a module that exports all four symbols.
